title: Buena Vista Hilltop Hideaway
description: Escape to this charming 1-bedroom apartment in Rincón, Puerto Rico! Nestled just a 4 minute drive up the hill from the vibrant town plaza, this cozy retreat offers stunning ocean views and a peaceful atmosphere. Perfect for a couple or solo traveler, it features a comfortable living space, well-equipped kitchen, and private balcony to enjoy the sunsets. Just minutes from local restaurants, beaches, and shops, this hilltop gem provides the perfect blend of relaxation and convenience.The spaceBuena Vista is all set for a relaxing stay. The property features 1 private bedroom with A/C and queen size bed. Living room has a comfortable sofa and futon to relax on and enjoy a movie or show. There is a full bathroom, and a fully stocked kitchen so if you feel like cooking, you're all set or dine out at one of the great local restaurants nearby. Outside you will find a private balcony with beautiful views of the mountains where you can sit back and relax. The town plaza with restaurants, shops and entertainment are a 5 minute drive as are the beaches. Enjoy yourself in our little slice of paradise.Guest accessGuest have access to the entire unit and balcony off back.Other things to noteWe do allow longer stays but require a cleaning preformed by our team once a month every month of the reservation. The fee will be our standard cleaning fee and will be covered by the guests.

description: This magical cabin facing the sea, with a large terrace, hammocks and chairs that persuade you to enjoy the sound of the waves of the sea. Plus, a mini BBQ grill, large patio, gated parking, and secure entry. It has a beautiful semi-private beach with an amazing view. It is a very quiet place that makes you feel at peace.The spaceA small and cozy house with a terrace facing the sea. With hammocks and furniture you can sit quietly enjoying the sound of the sea. The house has two kitchens, one inside the house and the other outside with a stove and grill. In addition, it has two rooms with a queen bed in each one. Perfect for two couples. It has two bathrooms with shower, one inside the house and the other outside the house. It is a very quiet, safe and perfect place to spend an excellent vacation. GUESS OPINIONS: This is a house that is right on the Caribbean Sea. The outdoor area is as beautiful as the pictures describe. There is a swimming beach about 300 feet from the back door. The property owner was very responsive. The location is on the West side of the island 2.5 hours from San Juan. 15 minutes from Rincón, 45 minutes from Gozalandia waterfalls; an hour from Parguera. The home is residential area and seemed very safe. We chose to eat at house and grocery store was less than 10 minutes from home. The home was very clean and has a shower and a faucet to rinse sand off. It had all the amenities of any property we’ve rented. Please note, the property has 2 private bedrooms and then a futon in the living room. Recommended for 4 persons or two couple.Guest accessThe house is located in front of the beach. The entire ground floor is for the use of guests. On the upper floor we have a mini-studio for our use, which does not interfere with anything on the ground floor.Other things to noteIt is suggested that you leave the vehicles in the starting position. It is not necessary to padlock the gate, just snap it together. If you go to the beach, keep the beach gate closed. Keep the keys safe, if you lose the keys there will be a charge of $30.00 for each of the keys.

description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceRomantic, private, and overlooking the most beautiful sunsets on the island, Villa Primavera at The Villas at The Horned Dorset is the epitome of luxury in paradise. Villa Primavera is a one-bedroom, 2 full baths, privately owned luxury property with a private plunge pool on the terrace overlooking the Caribbean Sea. This complex offers a full-size generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service.The villa is steps away from a stunning shared infinity pool and the beach is a one-minute walk away. On this beach, you can enjoy a morning or afternoon dip, appreciate the scenery and let the waves caress your feet. If you are looking to relax, enjoy quiet surroundings, and still have all the fun and action Rincon has to offer a short drive away, then this is the place for you! IMPORTANT NOTE #1: This villa is not located at The Horned Dorset Hotel (which is closed). It is located at the Villas at Horned Dorset, directly besides the hotel. The common areas and pool of the Villas are in pristine condition. Once you get off the main road, you will encounter narrow countryside roads for approx 3-5 minutes until you get to the property.IMPORTANT NOTE #2 - PLUNGE POOL MAINTENANCE: The pool man has to access the outdoor patio every Thursday during the morning to clean the plunge pool. No exceptions. Guests do not need to be at the property for this, since they don't need access to the unit. Please reach out to us before booking if you have any questions regarding this service. LIVING AREASYou will never get tired of the relaxing ocean views seen from the open layout living and dining room. There is a 4 person dining table, satellite TV, central AC, and a pull-out sofa bed (only recommended for children, not adults). The room is elegantly furnished for sophisticated relaxation by the Caribbean Sea. The living and dining room opens to the terrace via two gorgeous wooden doors. The terrace has a private plunge pool overlooking the water and 2 lounge chairs for sunbathing in privacy. The property includes satellite WiFi for basic internet use (web browsing and emails) - it is not high speed and cannot be used to download movies or heavy data files.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite is located on the second level of the villa. Upstairs, the ocean views get even better. The villa offers a four-poster mahogany king-size bed, Amalfi ceramics, hand-carved furniture, and a separate sitting area. The grand suite has a luxurious bathroom covered from floor to ceiling with white Carrara marble and features a beautiful oversized freestanding white porcelain bathtub, a shower and His & Hers sinks. There is no TV in the master bedroom.PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENETTEThe kitchenette is located on the 1st level of the villa. It offers a small refrigerator, a toaster, microwave oven, a single burner portable stovetop, a blender, and basic pots and pans for simple cooking. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation.The villa includes one (1) unassigned parking spot.LOCATION There are many things to do in Rincon, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincon you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the secluded beach, private plunge pool, and infinity pool at The Villas at The Horned Dorset. This oceanfront property has a private area where guests can wet their feet in the ocean and soak up the sun. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture at the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddleboard tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle BoardsOther things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish spongePlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 2 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

description: Enjoy Rincon with your whole family in Casa Rubia, a newly renovated 3 bedroom, 2 full plus 2 half bathroom villa featuring a unique glass enclosed third floor atrium and a shared swimming pool for relaxing. Casa Rubia is located steps from three of Rincon's most popular beaches (Playa Antonio, Sandy Beach, and Pool's Beach) in the heart of Barrio Puntas. Within walking distance are some of the best restaurants and nightlife. The village shared pool is available at all hours.The spaceThis is a three story villa consisting of:1st floor- 3 air conditioned bedrooms that sleep up to 8 (the bunk beds are for ONLY children, NOT adults). Two full baths, one in master suite, one shared.Main floor- TV area plus full living/dining room (seats 6), full kitchen and breakfast bar with seating for 4. Garden view balcony with cafe table. Half bathroom and laundry room with stackable washer and dryer. Air conditioned and ceiling fans. 3rd floor Atrium- sectional sofa, kitchenette with blender and wine fridge, TV and bar seating.Initial toiletries and basics are supplied.Quiet time should be observed after 10pm, please.Guest accessYou will have access to the shared swimming pool and outdoor showers. Just outside the community gate there is a path to the right that leads to the beach. This is a surf break and may be too rough to swim. To the far right there quiet tide pools and lots of Seaglass and to the left a short walk down the beach there is super swimming at Sandy Beach.Two parking spaces are reserved for the villa directly in front of the villa.Other things to noteThe closest beach access is just outside the complex. Go down the hill and just past the greenery to your right there is a grassy path that leads to the beach. Be sure to visit Art Walk on Thursday evenings in the Rincón plaza (local artists, many diverse restaurants, live music, Rincon Beer Company for island brews). The Rincón lighthouse is a favorite local spot for beautiful sunset views and an overlook of Domes beach and surf break. If you have time to explore; La Parguera, San Sebastián waterfalls and electric scooter rentals in Isabella.

title: Happiness 2 & 4 - Beautiful 2BR/2BA @ Sandy Beach
description: Happiness By the Beach is located in the heart of Puntas, Rincon PR. We are right across the street from the beautiful Sandy beach, breathtaking beach views, restaurants, mini market, surfboard rentals, beach front yoga classes and more. At our place you'll enjoy beautiful, elegant, modern and comfortable lodgings with access to a beautiful patio with a relaxing pool with sun loungers for sunbathing, grill area, and luxurious lounge area patio furniture under an opulent pergola. Stay, BE HAPPY!The spaceHappiness By the Beach is a modern, exclusive, newly renovated building with 2 apartments and two studios on the first floor. The second floor has two apartments with independent entrances. The main entrance leads to a beautiful patio with an opulent pergola, underneath which there is an exquisite lounging area with luxurious outdoor patio furniture and an awesome grill area. in the patio you'll also find beautifully relaxing pool, a gorgeous mural by local artist, Albert Padilla, and sun loungers for sunbathing. The entrances to Units 1-3 are on the right side of the patio with glass doors and windows to let in the light and to appreciate the view of the patio from the inside. Hotel-like black out curtains are installed for the guest to use should you desire privacyUnit 2 & 4 are joined by a connecting door. Unit 2 is a one-bedroom apartment and unit 4 studio. Together, Units 2 & 4 are suited for 6 guests. The one-bedroom apartment (Unit 2) has a full-sized bed, a futon in the living room, bathroom, kitchen, dining table for 4 plus 2 extra stools, workspace in the bedroom, and TV in the living room. A connecting double door joins to Unit 4, a studio equipped with a full bed, kitchenette, workspace, TV and bathroom. Units 2 & 4 features include: Futon sleeper, Plush full bed x 2, bed and bath linens, flat screen smart TV x2, complimentary wireless internet, private bathroom, microwave oven x2, fridge, mini fridge, coffee maker x2, stove top in unit 2, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, and beach towels. The enclosed property includes a beautiful pool, sun loungers, luxury patio furniture, gas and coal grills (BBQ) and outdoor shower. The whole building is equipped with an automatic generator to protect your vacation investment from common island power outages.Guest accessAt the property, guest have access to pool, outdoor shower, gas and coal grill (BBQ), sun loungers and outdoor patio lounge.The neighborhood in very walkable, but you will most likely want a car to go downtown, visit other beaches and other parts of the island and to do grocery shopping.There is free onsite parking at the property and on the street.Other things to noteWhile we provide internet service, generator in case of very common power outages and water in case water goes out as well, we do ask that you are conscious that these are not fail proof. We have a regular maintenance schedule to keep our premises and our services in the best conditions possible. If any of these were to fail during your stay rest assured, we will do everything in our power to resolve the issue in a timely manner, also taking into consideration the maintenance personnel and technician’s availability and abilities. *If the power goes out, unfortunately Unit 4 is the closest to the generator and noise is to be expected. We provide earplugs if needed."

description: Escape to paradise in this spacious 2-room apartment, perfect for families or groups of friends. The apartment features 3 private bathrooms, 2 balconies, 1 king bed, 1 queen bed, 1 futon and a full kitchen. The apartment caters to a maximum of 6 people and is located on the 2nd floor with partial ocean view. The property is a self-catering guesthouse and additional information is available on-site. Please note that this room is non-smoking and NOT pet-friendly.The spaceHi! Welcome to Paradise! Please be aware that this unit is not standalone property. Common areas are shared with other guests staying in other rooms. All rooms have private entrances and bathrooms. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessThe room has a lockbox with the key inside next to its door. On check in date, we will be sending you a code to gain access to your room at any time after 3pm. Our check in time is 3pm and check out time is 11:30am. Please review your information as room cannot be changed on arrival date because of # of people, location, number of beds, or preferences. Cancelations, modifications, or changes of dates must be done 24 hrs before check in date.Other things to notePlease keep in mind that we do not have a power generator. If we lose electricity during your stay, we won't be able to provide other alternatives. We do have water tanks. Internet may fail during your stay do to power outages and/or repairs being done by the island's electric company.
